properties.digitization_method: 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL Assessor parcel geometry (not approximate), but the local basemap (data/raw/parcels.geojson, buildings.geojson) was fetched to an older, slightly smaller bounding box that stops just north of this parcel, so the grey basemap land/building texture is blank immediately around this shape on the map -- cosmetic only; the parcel's own outline and position are exact. Fix: widen src/config.py's BBOX_SOUTH and re-fetch the raw layers. That this is a real Assessor parcel rests on DataSF Parcels (acdm-wktn), which lists blklot 4241004 as an active parcel addressed 1215 MICHIGAN; the Chronicle article names the address but does not discuss the parcel.'; digitized_from: 'The real DataSF Assessor parcel for blklot 4241004 (1215 Michigan St, 4.07 acres, zoned PDR-1-G), fetched directly from the DataSF Socrata API (data.sfgov.org/resource/acdm-wktn.json, dataset 'Parcels - Active and Retired') on 2026-09-21. Routed through this table, not status.csv, only because the parcel sits just south of data/raw/parcels.geojson's cached bounding box (src/config.py's BBOX_SOUTH=37.7545; this parcel's northern edge is ~37.7542) and so isn't in that local extract -- the polygon itself is the real, unmodified Assessor shape, not hand-traced or approximated. A small blklot 4241003 (~0.25 acres) immediately west, also addressed 1215 Michigan St, is not included: the Chronicle's reporting and the Assessor's own lot_area (177,223 sq ft = 4.07 acres) both point to 4241004 as 'the' 4-acre parcel in question.'. 2026-10-12 accuracy audit (text only; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): the digitized_from figure of 177,223 sq ft (4.07 acres) is the lot_area field of DataSF's Secured Property Tax Rolls (wv5m-vpq2, closed_roll_year 2025, parcel_number 4241004, property_location '0000 1215 MICHIGAN ST0000', lot_area '177223.0'), not a field of the Parcels dataset (acdm-wktn), which for blklot 4241004 gives from_address_num 1215, street_name MICHIGAN, zoning_code PDR-1-G, active true and no area. digitized_from and source_doc_urls now name that dataset. The drawn outline measures about 4.1 acres (about 16,470 m2 by a local planar calculation on 2026-10-12; an audit using a different projection measured about 16,540 m2), consistent with the roll's figure within projection error.
properties.digitized_from: The real DataSF Assessor parcel for blklot 4241004 (1215 Michigan St, 4.07 acres, zoned PDR-1-G), taken directly from DataSF's open data portal (data.sfgov.org/resource/acdm-wktn.json, dataset 'Parcels - Active and Retired') on 2026-09-21. Stored as a separately drawn shape rather than linked by block/lot only because the parcel sits just south of the area covered by this map's local copy of the Assessor parcel data (which stops at latitude 37.7545; this parcel's northern edge is ~37.7542) -- the polygon itself is the real, unmodified Assessor shape, not hand-traced or approximated. A small blklot 4241003 (~0.25 acres) immediately west, also addressed 1215 Michigan St, is not included: the Chronicle's reporting and the lot_area in DataSF's Secured Property Tax Rolls (dataset wv5m-vpq2, 2025 roll: 177,223 sq ft = 4.07 acres; the Parcels dataset itself has no area field, and the lot's drawn outline measures about 4.1 acres) both point to 4241004 as 'the' 4-acre parcel in question.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL Assessor parcel geometry (not approximate), but the map's grey background layer of land and buildings covers an older, slightly smaller area that stops just north of this parcel, so that background is blank immediately around this shape on the map -- cosmetic only; the parcel's own outline and position are exact. The background layer has not yet been extended. That this is a real Assessor parcel rests on DataSF Parcels (acdm-wktn), which lists blklot 4241004 as an active parcel addressed 1215 MICHIGAN; the Chronicle article names the address but does not discuss the parcel.
properties.notes: Sheedy Drayage, a crane rental and heavy-hauling company, currently operates on the site under owner R.P. Stagg & Co. LLC (as reported by the San Francisco Chronicle; not independently confirmed against a Recorder deed). The Chronicle reported in Sept 2026 that the exact status of any proposal was unclear and that no plans for a data center appeared to have been filed with the city -- see the record file for what's sourced about the proposal itself. Status is 'existing': the site is an operating industrial yard today, and a data center is only a reported possibility, not a plan of record. Use is 'industrial' for the same reason (the Chronicle describes a crane-rental and heavy-hauling yard); on the map it shows under Other, not as a commercial data center.
